dependent_disqualification.observation_prompt: Extract only factual arguments needed by the kernel. Identify the person and calendar year named in the question. Extract explicit statutory givens saying that an individual is a taxpayer's qualifying child or qualifying relative for a stated taxpayer year. Preserve direction exactly: X being Y's child is not evidence that Y is X's child. Do not infer qualifying status from kinship alone and do not decide whether section 152(b)(1) applies. For each channel, mark resolved only after inspecting the complete supplied facts and extracting its finite set; otherwise mark unknown. An unknown channel is not an empty array. Return nonempty verbatim witnesses from the current facts or question and list any factual uncertainty that prevents faithful extraction.

legal_separation_status.observation_prompt: Extract factual decree evidence only, without deciding whether section 7703(a)(2) applies. Identify the queried person and year. Preserve the direction individual-to-spouse and accept only a decree of divorce or separate maintenance. Use closed_interval only with a supported ending date, effective_through_close only when the text or native case semantics supports that the decree remained effective through December 31 of the queried year, and onset_only when only its effective date is supported. A dated event alone must not be extended arbitrarily into future years. Mark the decree channel resolved only after inspecting all supplied facts and extracting its finite set; otherwise mark it unknown. Return nonempty verbatim current witnesses and describe unresolved or unlowerable factual evidence.

separate_return_itemization_gate.observation_prompt: Extract factual events only; do not decide whether section 63(c)(6)(A) applies. Identify the queried person and year. Represent marriage evidence in a source-native form directed to the relevant individual: closed_interval only when both endpoints are stated; onset_only when only commencement is supported; ongoing_through_close when the text and native case timing support marriage from the stated start through December 31 of the queried year. In particular, 'has/have been married since D' describes onset plus an ongoing state; never turn it into an interval ending on D. Do not extend a state beyond the queried close or another supported endpoint. Extract divorce or separate-maintenance decree evidence similarly. Extract actual separate/not-separate filing statements. Under the shared native interpretation, an expressly allowed itemized deduction amount is an itemized=true event for that person and year; generic income or mere possible eligibility is not. Mark a channel resolved only after inspecting the complete facts and extracting its finite set; unknown is not empty. Return nonempty verbatim current witnesses and state unlowerable or unresolved factual uncertainty.

taxpayer_blind_year_end.observation_prompt: Extract blindness facts only; do not decide whether section 63(f)(2)(A) applies. Identify the queried taxpayer and year, and preserve the subject: a spouse's blindness is not the taxpayer's blindness. Prefer an explicit status at a stated date when supplied. Otherwise extract a supported closed blindness interval or an onset together with its expressly supported persistence. Do not infer that blindness persists indefinitely merely from an onset, and do not extend a status into an arbitrary future year. For each of the status, interval, and onset channels, mark resolved only after inspecting the complete facts and extracting its finite set; unknown is not an empty array. Return nonempty verbatim witnesses from the current facts or question and list any uncertainty or evidence that cannot be normalized without inventing a date.

dependent_disqualification.observation_prompt: Read only the current facts and question. Return every coherent factual view supported by the text. Identify the queried person and calendar year. Extract all explicit statutory givens that an individual is a taxpayer's qualifying child or qualifying relative for a stated taxpayer year. Preserve the directed arguments exactly: individual being taxpayer's child is not the inverse relation, and a person's own child does not make that person somebody else's qualifying child. Use [] only after resolving the finite case and finding no such given; use null for unread or failed extraction. Each view must include nonempty verbatim witnesses from the current facts or question. Do not decide section applicability, legal eligibility, entailment, contradiction, or any final answer.

legal_separation_status.observation_prompt: Read only the current facts and question and return every coherent factual view. Identify the queried person and year. Extract directed decrees of divorce or separate maintenance. Use ongoing_from only where the text or native case semantics supports that the decree/status continues from the effective date; use effective_only where only the dated decree is supported and its later persistence is not established; use closed_interval only when both endpoints are supported. Do not invent an end date or assume arbitrary future permanence. Use [] only after resolving the finite case and finding no qualifying decree, and null for unread or failed extraction. Each view must contain nonempty verbatim witnesses from the current facts or question. Do not determine statutory marital status, applicability, eligibility, entailment, contradiction, or any final legal answer.

separate_return_itemization_gate.observation_prompt: Read only factual statements in the current facts and question and return every coherent supported view. Identify the queried person and year. Represent marriage in its source-native form: ongoing_since for wording that the marriage has been in force since a date; onset_only when only commencement is supported; closed_interval only when both endpoints are explicitly supported. Never invent an end date. Represent divorce or separate-maintenance decrees as ongoing_from only when text or native case semantics supports continuing status, effective_only when only a dated decree is supported, and closed_interval when both endpoints are supported. Extract actual separate/not-separate return facts. Under the shared native interpretation, an expressly allowed itemized deduction amount is an itemized=true event; generic income or merely possible eligibility is not. Use [] only for a resolved finite channel with no event and null for unread or failed extraction. Include nonempty verbatim current facts/question witnesses in every view. Do not decide marital status under the statute, section applicability, eligibility, entailment, contradiction, or a final answer.

taxpayer_blind_year_end.observation_prompt: Read only factual statements in the current facts and question and return every coherent supported view. Identify the queried taxpayer and year; do not substitute a spouse or another person. Extract explicit blindness status at a stated date separately from source-native blindness events. Represent 'has been blind since' or equivalent continuing-state wording as ongoing_since; represent a bare onset with no supported continuation as onset_only; represent an expressly bounded period as closed_interval; and represent persistence only through an expressly supported date as ongoing_through. Do not invent recovery dates or arbitrary future permanence. Use [] only for a resolved finite channel containing no fact and null for unread or failed extraction. Include nonempty verbatim current facts/question witnesses in every view. Do not decide the year-end statutory condition, eligibility, applicability, entailment, contradiction, or any final answer.
